hypothesis: The sum of small-minus-large-bank four-release log-growth spreads in Other deposits and Commercial and industrial loans from each official Federal Reserve H.8 dated release predicts the next-week KRE versus KBE relative return; positive signals hold long KRE/short KBE and negative signals reverse the pair until the first open after the next release.

new_evidence_axis: A genuinely new official data source and gate shape: 81 dated Federal Reserve H.8 release vintages plus four lag anchors were parsed into a weekly market-neutral KRE/KBE relative-value allocator.

parameters.entry: first regular-session open strictly after publication
parameters.exit: first regular-session open strictly after the next publication

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not invert the sign, sweep lag lengths, substitute nearby H.8 rows, add a threshold or neutral band, change the response function, alter notional/costs, switch entry or exit clocks, replace KRE/KBE with neighboring bank ETFs, or slice the same 85 frozen releases. Those are same-signal retunes after a Gate-4 rejection.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Park this H.8 deposit/C&I lag4 pair family. Reopen only with a genuinely new data source or a substantively new economic signal, or with materially more prospectively settled unchanged-policy rows meeting the repository forward-row threshold and positive replacement value; a same-day recount or parameter sweep is insufficient.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The bank-size signal had essentially no gross directional edge: 39 of 78 weeks were gross winners but aggregate gross PnL was only +$94.96. Fixed $28 pair costs consumed $2,184, leaving only 8 net-positive weeks, three negative windows, -$2,089.04 net PnL, negative EV, 92.70% top-five positive-week concentration, and losses versus every required matched comparator.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: Small-versus-large bank four-release deposit and C&I growth should reveal funding and credit transmission that appears first in KRE versus KBE relative returns.
pre_run_questions.2_history_check: The novelty gate found no prior H.8 dated-vintage weekly pair family; the final dedicated fingerprint has no blocking near neighbor.
pre_run_questions.3_single_policy_bundle: One fixed lag4 two-row signal, direction mapping, strict weekly clock, equal gross notional, and cost contract; helper, replay, source freeze, sentinel fields, and seed only make that policy measurable and reproducible.
pre_run_questions.4_success_failure_standard: The preregistered Gate 1-4 rule required at least 20 settled pairs per window, positive aggregate pair PnL/EV, at least two positive windows, combined PnL/EV improvement, drawdown and concentration limits, and wins over cash/SPY/QQQ/KRE/KBE.

reproduction.deterministic_offline_replay: The frozen source and OHLCV rebuilt the in-memory result exactly after removing only the stored output_bundle wrapper; all four child canonical payload hashes matched.
reproduction.first_full_attempt: Failed closed before evaluation artifacts on a diagnostic-only static-comparator accumulator KeyError; the accumulator was repaired without changing binding comparators or viewing/retuning policy outcomes, and one inspected offline retry completed.
reproduction.independent_outcome_audit: 356 source, timing, price, fixed-share, cost, comparator, PIT, and output-identity checks passed with no P0/P1 finding.

residual_unknowns: Historical ETF association cannot prove that the H.8 balance-sheet split caused the relative return.
The baseline has less than $12 minimum cash in every window, so the combined curve is an external-capital diagnostic rather than a cash-conserving allocation.
Historical short availability, borrow fees, margin, displacement, and kill-switch parity were not modeled; these block live eligibility independently of the Gate-4 rejection.
No prospectively settled unchanged-policy pair rows or complete selection pool exist, so DSR is not computable.

source.source_identity_caveat: The official Fed full-page HTML contains client-dependent dynamic bytes: two independent clients differed on all 85 raw bodies even though Table 6/8 line 10/36 values matched exactly. Raw page hashes are archived as retrieval provenance but are explicitly non-comparable; the cross-client-stable semantic table-value hashes are the binding source identity.
